contentHtml:
The Atlanta Dream will face the New York Liberty in a decisive WNBA regular season game. A victory could prevent the Liberty from dropping to 8th place and secure a more favorable schedule for the Washington Mystics.

What Changes in the Standings After the Game

The outcome of the clash could ensure the Liberty finish in 7th or 8th place. The Washington Mystics, who have an easier schedule for the end of the season, could benefit from this positioning.

Why Atlanta Has the Advantage

The Dream are favorites at home and have won four consecutive games, aiming for 3rd place in the league. The team had five players score in double digits in their last game and leads the league in post-All-Star offensive and defensive rating.

The Role of Rebounding Statistics

Reese, from the Liberty, has been identified as a “fade” candidate in rebound betting, having grabbed only 10 boards in her last game. She has failed to reach 11 boards in two of 42 games this year, despite averaging 12.3. The Dream have a strong frontcourt with Jonquel Jones and Breanna Stewart.

High Scoring Expectation

Both teams are among the top five in scoring in the league, totaling 179 points in the Dream's last victory. The Dream have recorded 95 or more points in three games since the end of the 2026 World Cup. The combined average of the two teams exceeds 181 points per game.

Betting Considerations

Due to the high expected score and the short spread, the recommendation is to bet on a game with a high total score, rather than choosing a specific winner.

With information from Sports Illustrated.
